description: This Java class defines a concrete strategy for handling the 'ModifyFeatureProperties' command within an actor-based architecture for managing 'Thing' entities. It encapsulates logic for modifying or creating feature properties on a 'Thing', including size validation, extracting features, and generating appropriate event and response objects.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertiesStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing a command strategy for modifying or creating feature properties on a 'Thing' entity, ensuring proper size validation, feature extraction, and event/result generation.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the strategy to modify feature properties, involving size validation and feature extraction, ultimately returning a result with an event or error.

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Extracts a feature from a 'Thing' based on the feature ID provided in the command.

methods.name: getModifyOrCreateResult
methods.description: Determines whether to modify existing feature properties or create new ones, based on whether the feature's properties are present.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Constructs a mutation result indicating successful modification of feature properties.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Constructs a mutation result indicating creation of new feature properties.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tag representing the previous state of the feature's properties for concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the entity tag for the new feature properties after modification.
